purpose: Early explanatory analysis for one LLM deployment, not a comparison of LLMs
readiness: All 60 cases attempted; at least 58 completed provider responses; at least 15 successes and 15 failures; passed collection audit

logistic_regression.family: Binomial with logit link, unpenalized maximum likelihood
logistic_regression.outcome: Assisted exact official first-move success among completed provider responses
logistic_regression.checks: Convergence, finite coefficients and standard errors, no perfect-separation warning

decision_tree.algorithm: Numeric CART with greedy Gini splits, deterministic feature/threshold tie order
decision_tree.implementation: Checked NumPy implementation; portable JSON artifact; Matplotlib drawing

limits: Balanced small sample, legal-choice assistance, possible residual technical failures and model-specific deployment restrict generalization. No held-out prediction accuracy or full-sequence solving claim.
